rounds.name: Worker-Kerr
rounds.text:
I’ll trust Worker‑Kerr because they report a perfect record: 10 of 10 previous dealings were faithful. This indicates a high likelihood of a proper job.

rounds.text:
Worker-Kerr has a perfect record of keeping faith with others, and in our only prior interaction they completed the task properly.  The expected payoff from withholding (≈4.5 tasks) exceeds the guaranteed 3 tasks from trusting, and the risk of a technical failure is only 10%.
